# UploadVR - 4.5/5

**"One of the Best!"**

Among Giants is an open-world game where the player gets to explore the planet at their own pace, deciphering the alien language to get a better understanding of what has happened to humanity by hunting down colossal giants that roam the world and extracting their final memories.
[media]

# The Giants and Others
The game has over 10 different types of enemies you will encounter from smaller Droids to a huge Spider Queen or the Giant Death Worm
[media]

# Meet R-011
Befriend a feisty tiny Roller Droid, your gateway to understanding this world who will eventually be your closest ally. R-011 will be your Hacker, your Protector and your Friend
[media]

# Your Horse
Explore the huge alien world by riding your trusty steed. You can call for your horse anywhere with your Horn
[media]

# Your Bow & Arrow
Find special Quivers for your bow to help tackle those tricky targets
[media]

# Grappling Hooks
Traverse across the land using your grappling hooks and also use them to break open crates
[media]

# Gliding
Outstretch your arms to glide your way to safety or distant platforms
[media]

# Other Weapons
There are many other types of weaponry found in the world but use them wisely as they cannot be reloaded
[media]

# Hack Terminals & Locks
Decipher the alien language a character at a time by hacking terminals and also break into buildings and gates by pick locking
[media]

# Realtime Day & Night with Weather Systems
The battleground changes constantly when the day turns to night. Fight through heavy rain, a freezing blizzard and even in a scorching desert
[media]
